2607.20814.title: Enhancing Explainable Cardiac Diagnosis with Guide-Grounded Multimodal LLMs
2607.20814.paper_summary: The electrocardiogram (ECG) is a cornerstone of cardiac as- sessment, yet clinical deployment of deep learning models remains con- strained by limited interpretability and the hallucination risk of large language models (LLMs). Existing CNN+Grad-CAM+multimodal LLM frameworks can generate ECG reports, but their explanations are often only weakly grounded in established diagnostic criteria, reducing trust- worthiness and reproducibility. We propose a guide-grounded multimodal framework that explicitly anchors report generation in curated clinical knowledge. A convolutional neural network (CNN) and Grad-CAM first produce class probabilities and class-specific heatmaps from 12-lead ECG images. In parallel, authoritative ECG textbooks and guideline materials are distilled offline into a structured ECG Interpretation Guide, which is injected as a fixed knowledge block for every sample. Conditioned on the ECG image, Grad-CAM overlay, CNN-derived fact pack, and the in- jected guide, a multimodal LLM generates structured diagnostic reports with guideline-consistent terminology and criteria usage. Experiments on the full PTB-XL test set demonstrate that guide grounding improves se- mantic quality and perceived consistency of generated reports while pre- serving competitive classification performance. In particular, our method increases the average BERTScore of generated impressions from 0.818 to 0.953 relative to a strong CNN+Grad-CAM+MLLM baseline, indicat- ing closer alignment with reference reports. These findings suggest that injecting a distilled interpretation guide into the multimodal prompting pipeline offers a practical pathway to reduce hallucinations and enhance the clinical plausibility of LLM-based ECG explanations, bringing ex- plainable cardiac diagnosis closer to real-world deployment.
2607.20814.paper_summary_zh: 心電圖（ECG）是心臟評估的基石，但深度學習模型在臨床應用中的部署仍然受到有限可解釋性和大型語言模型（LLMs）幻覺風險的限制。現有的CNN+Grad-CAM+多模態LLM框架可以生成ECG報告，但它們的解釋往往僅僅是基於既定診斷標準的薄弱基礎，降低了可信度和可重複性。我們提出了一種以指南為基礎的多模態框架，明確將報告生成固定在策劃的臨床知識中。一個卷積神經網絡（CNN）和Grad-CAM首先從12導聯ECG圖像生成類別概率和類別特定的熱圖。與此同時，權威的ECG教科書和指導材料被離線提煉成一個結構化的ECG解釋指南，這作為每個樣本的固定知識塊被注入。根據ECG圖像、Grad-CAM疊加、CNN生成的事實包和注入的指南，這個多模態LLM生成結構化的診斷報告，使用與指南一致的術語和標準。對完整的PTB-XL測試集的實驗表明，指南基礎的改進提高了生成報告的語義質量和感知一致性，同時保持了競爭性的分類性能。特別是，我們的方法將生成印象的平均BERTScore從0.818提高到0.953，相對於一個強大的CNN+Grad-CAM+MLLM基線，這表明與參考報告的對齊更為緊密。這些發現表明，將提煉的解釋指南注入多模態提示管道提供了一條實用途徑，以減少幻覺並增強基於LLM的ECG解釋的臨床合理性，使可解釋的心臟診斷更接近實際部署。
